tagline: 雅西卡取景器相机，1988 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1988年推出的取景器相机。快门速度1/125 (35 mm), 1/60 (55 mm).。感光度100–400 (DX coded films). Non-DX film is set to ISO 100.。Fixed focus, 1,5 m to infinity.。

specs.感光度: 100–400 (DX coded films). Non-DX film is set to ISO 100.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, manually activated. Under exposure warning lamp. Range (at ISO 100) 1–2,5 m (wide), 1,2–2 m (tele).
specs.英文简介: The Yashica DF-10 or Kyocera J-Tele is a 1988 budget compact camera with two focal lengths: 35 and 55 mm.
